#3 split neighbourhoods
```{r}

match_model_data_c <- filter(match_model_data_songs, neighbourhood == "centre")
```

#4 dfs for north neighbourhood 
```{r}
# Get all unique focal IDs (excluding NAs)
focal_ids <- unique(na.omit(match_model_data_n$ID))

# Initialize an empty list to store the output dataframes
focal_outputs_n <- list()

# Loop through each focal ID
for (focal_id in focal_ids) {
  
  # focals_data is just rows in which ID = focal_id
  focals_data <- filter(match_model_data_n, ID == focal_id)
  
  # focal_rep is the unique set of USTs for the focal (including NA)
  focal_rep <- unique(focals_data$UST)
  
  # focal_ind is all match_model_data_n rows that have a UST that is in focal's repertoire, not including NA 
  focal_ind <- match_model_data_n %>% 
    filter(UST %in% focal_rep & !is.na(UST))
  
  # take focal_ind and group by date (could be a problem?), create columns focal_next_UST to show the focal's next UST
  focal_ind <- focal_ind %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    mutate(focal_next_UST = if_else(ID == focal_id, UST, NA))  %>%
    fill(focal_next_UST, .direction = "up") 
  
  # adds column focal_matches. If the focal bird is the singer, it can't be a match (thus "NA"). 
  
  # If the focal bird is not the singer, does the song type match focal's next song (within day). 
  focal_ind <- focal_ind %>%
    mutate(focal_matches = if_else(ID == focal_id, NA,
                                   if_else(focal_next_UST == UST, 1, 0))) 
  
  # Coordinates for focal male and singing male
  coords1 <- cbind(focal_ind$M1_Lat, focal_ind$M1_Lon)
  coords2 <- cbind(focal_ind$Lat, focal_ind$Lon)
  
  # Distance matrix is a function of the two coordinate sets
  dist_matrix <- distm(coords1, coords2, fun = distHaversine)
  
  # Take diagonal to estimate distances
  focal_ind$dist_to_focal <- diag(dist_matrix)
  
  # Makes column "Focal_ID"
  focal_ind$Focal_ID <- focal_id 
  
  # Makes column time_focals_last_song with the time of the focal's last song 
  # NAs at the top of each day until the focal sings
  focal_ind <- focal_ind %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    mutate(time_focals_last_song = if_else(ID == focal_id, time_rel_sunrise, NA)) %>%
    fill(time_focals_last_song, .direction = "down")  %>%
    mutate(time_since_focals_last_song = time_rel_sunrise - time_focals_last_song) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Makes "just_focal_time" column which contains the time of focal's songs
    mutate(just_focal_time = ifelse(ID == focal_id , time_rel_sunrise, NA))
  
  # First groups by date AND UST (so code works within UST, within date), 
  # then makes column "time_focals_last_rend_ST" which shows the time the focal last sang that ST.
  # Fill that down (still within UST, within date) or else it just returns one value per focal song.
  focal_ind <- focal_ind %>%
    group_by(date, UST) %>%
    mutate(time_focals_last_rend_ST = lag(just_focal_time)) %>%
    fill(time_focals_last_rend_ST, .direction = "down")  %>%
    mutate(time_since_focals_last_rend_ST = -1 * (time_focals_last_rend_ST - time_rel_sunrise))
  
  # Makes "lean" dataframe by selecting only the necessary variables, 
  # then removing the focal's songs (which he cannot match) and ungrouping.
  focal_ind_lean <- focal_ind %>%
    select(index, Focal_ID, date, ID, time_rel_sunrise, UST, number_of_matches, 
           does_it_match, focal_matches, dist_to_focal, time_since_focals_last_song, 
           time_focals_last_rend_ST, time_since_focals_last_rend_ST, 
           note_count:time_since_focals_last_rend_ST) %>%
    filter(ID != focal_id) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Save the lean dataframe to the list using a name like "LbOW_ind_lean"
  output_name <- paste0(focal_id, "_ind_lean")
  focal_outputs_n[[output_name]] <- focal_ind_lean
}

# You can now access the outputs like:
# focal_outputs_n$LbOW_ind_lean
# focal_outputs_n$TbTbLg_ind_lean
TbTbLg_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$TbTbLg_ind_lean
RRO_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$RRO_ind_lean
LbOW_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$LbOW_ind_lean
DgTbO_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$DgTbO_ind_lean
YKY_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$YKY_ind_lean
RbDgY_ind_lean_n <- focal_outputs_n$RbDgY_ind_lean
```

#7.5 relative performance
```{r}
# note_count, avg_note_gap_ratio_nl_s, avg_note_FM_nl_s, avg_silent_gap_FM_nl

# Step 1: Ensure all key columns are character (to avoid type mismatch)
ind_model_data <- ind_model_data %>%
  mutate(
    UST = as.character(UST),
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Focal_ID = as.character(Focal_ID)
  )

# Step 2: Compute group means: mean performance for each UST + ID combo
avg_perf_table <- ind_model_data %>%
  group_by(UST, ID) %>%
  summarise(
    focal_avg_note_count = mean(note_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    focal_avg_note_gap_ratio_nl = mean(avg_note_gap_ratio_nl, na.rm = TRUE),
    focal_avg_note_FM_nl = mean(avg_note_FM_nl, na.rm = TRUE),
    focal_avg_gap_FM_nl = mean(avg_silent_gap_FM_nl, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Join this back to the original df using UST and Focal_ID
ind_model_data <- ind_model_data %>%
  left_join(avg_perf_table, by = c("UST" = "UST", "Focal_ID" = "ID"))

# Make relative performance variables (>0 means focal is better)
ind_model_data <- ind_model_data %>%
  mutate (rel_note_count = focal_avg_note_count - note_count)  %>%
  mutate (rel_note_gap_ratio = focal_avg_note_gap_ratio_nl - avg_note_gap_ratio_nl)  %>%
  mutate (rel_note_FM = focal_avg_note_FM_nl - avg_note_FM_nl)  %>%
  mutate (rel_gap_FM = focal_avg_gap_FM_nl - avg_silent_gap_FM_nl)  


```

#11 Priors
```{r}
#Getting priors

# Using note level relative  performance variables 
# reduce dataset
ind_model_data_min_2 <- select(ind_model_data, focal_matches, dist_to_focal_s, time_since_focals_last_rend_ST_s, time_since_focals_last_song_s, time_rel_sunrise_s, rel_note_count_s, rel_note_gap_ratio_s, rel_note_FM_s, rel_gap_FM_s, UST, index, Focal_ID, dyad, ID)

# With univariate acoustic vars (replaced TR and BW w VD)
get_prior_10 <- get_prior(focal_matches ~ dist_to_focal_s + time_since_focals_last_rend_ST_s +  s(time_rel_sunrise_s) + rel_note_count_s + rel_note_gap_ratio_s + rel_note_FM_s + rel_gap_FM_s + (1|UST) + (1|index) + (1|Focal_ID) + (1|dyad) + (1|ID), family="bernoulli", data = ind_model_data_min_2)

get_prior_10[1,1] <- "normal(0,1)"

```

#12 The models
```{r}

# with note level performance variables
# Univariate acoustics
fit.matching.21 <- brm(focal_matches ~ dist_to_focal_s + time_since_focals_last_rend_ST_s +  s(time_rel_sunrise_s) + rel_note_count_s + rel_note_gap_ratio_s + rel_note_FM_s + rel_gap_FM_s + (1|UST) + (1|index) + (1|Focal_ID) + (1|dyad) + (1|ID), family="bernoulli", data = ind_model_data_min_2, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 10), iter = 4000, chains = 4, prior = get_prior_10, cores = 4)
```
